metadata.title: SOX ITGC Profile (framework-mapped, home lab)
metadata.remarks: Resolves the owned control library into the SOX IT general controls view across the access, change, and operations pillars: IAC-17 (access to programs and data), CHG-02 (change management and segregation of dev and approver), MON-01 (computer operations and monitoring of privileged activity). This association is framework mapping only (home lab) and is not represented as audited. No depth claim is made beyond the crosswalk line.
